name: Jest of the Draining Tomb
body:
School: Necromancy; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: Personal

Target: You

Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

The next time a creature attacks you before the end of your next turn, that creature deals 5 less damage on a successful hit. In addition, the attacking creature does not benefit from any situation that would normally deny you your Dexterity bonus to AC until the end of your next turn.
